systems.headline: From brief to production.
systems.subtext: Clarity first. Architecture second. Then ship.

step1.title: Discovery & scope
step1.desc: I define the problem, user flows, and success criteria — then the smallest version that ships value.

step2.title: Architecture & data design
step2.desc: API contracts, data models, auth, and service boundaries defined before a line of implementation is written.

step3.title: Build & iterate
step3.desc: Thin vertical slices from UI to API to data. Clean components, predictable state, readable code.

step4.title: Testing, docs & QA
step4.desc: Swagger docs, edge case coverage, and validation before every release. Stable code builds trust.

step5.title: Deployment & hosting
step5.desc: Containerized services, automated deployments, monitoring. The system stays healthy after launch.

josephbattisti.title: Joseph Battisti — NY Salon
josephbattisti.description: Full-stack booking platform with Shopify integration and real-time scheduling.
josephbattisti.subtitle: NY Salon.
josephbattisti.summary: A high-performance digital ecosystem for a premier Manhattan hair salon, integrating seamless booking and real-time availability.
josephbattisti.challenge: The legacy system suffered from performance, leading to poor UX/UI and a disjointed user experience for the elite clientele.
josephbattisti.solution: Implemented a robust secure API in NestJS and a reactive Angular front-end that provides instant feedback and connection to the API and Shopify.

ds.title: Dynamic Scheduling
ds.desc: Real-time availability engine with timezone intelligence and stylist slot management.

sv.title: Secure Vault
sv.desc: PCI-compliant payment processing via Shopify with encrypted client profile storage.

ie.title: Insight Engine
ie.desc: Business analytics dashboard for salon management with revenue and booking forecasts.

referral.title: Lending Group — Texas
referral.description: Lead-generation app for an employment and lending firm.
referral.subtitle: Texas.
referral.summary: A dedicated lead-generation application for a Texas-based lending group, optimizing employment-seeker workflows end-to-end.
referral.challenge: Manual lead tracking across spreadsheets caused friction in follow-ups, missed opportunities, and inconsistent data quality for the sales team.
referral.solution: Built a full-stack Angular + Express application with a structured MongoDB pipeline, automated email triggers, and a CI/CD workflow ensuring zero-downtime deployments.

lc.title: Lead Capture
lc.desc: Smart forms with validation and automatic CRM entry on submission.

af.title: Automated Follow-ups
af.desc: Trigger-based email sequences keeping leads warm without manual effort.

e.title: Exposure
e.desc: SEO and AI visibility to improve brand reach.

video.title: Esencial360 — Yoga & Meditation
video.description: Configurable subscription plan, BunnyStream video delivery, and admin tooling.
video.subtitle: Yoga & Meditation.
video.summary: A configurable wellness platform with BunnyStream video delivery, subscription plans, and a full admin tooling suite.
video.challenge: The client needed a platform that could gate premium content behind tiered subscriptions while delivering HD video without buffering, at scale.
video.solution: Integrated BunnyStream for CDN-backed video delivery and Stripe for subscription billing. Built a custom admin UI for instructors to manage content, users, and analytics.

vd.title: Video Delivery
vd.desc: BunnyStream CDN integration for sub-second video start times globally.

se.title: Subscription Engine
se.desc: Stripe-powered tiered plans with automatic access gating and renewals.

at.title: Admin Tooling
at.desc: Full content management, user administration, and analytics dashboard.
